item.title: Opinion: Can I keep the baseball I caught?
item.description: What would you do if you caught a baseball during the MLB playoffs? Give it to a kid nearby or keep it? This very scenario played out this week, with a fan deciding to keep the ball.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Ongoing lawsuits allege GLP-1s can cause serious harm. But we don't know how often
item.description: Scant data about serious adverse effects makes it harder to answer scientific and legal questions about how often the drugs might cause serious harm like blindness or pancreatitis.

item.title: A year of ceasefire in Gaza through the lens of NPR's reporter
item.description: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.

item.title: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
item.description: Indian authorities have launched a major security crackdown in New Delhi, detaining thousands of protesters who intended to hold a mass demonstration against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.

item.description: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

item.title: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
item.description: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

item.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
item.description: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.
